name: Al Manara
insider_take: Al Manara, meaning "The Lighthouse" in Arabic, stands as a beacon of luxury on the shores of the Red Sea in Aqaba — Jordan's only coastal city and a gateway to world-class diving, ancient history, and the golden deserts of Wadi Rum.
whats_special: This stunning Luxury Collection property is styled after a traditional Jordanian fortress, with sand-toned architecture, handcrafted interiors, and panoramic Red Sea views that stretch toward Saudi Arabia, Israel, and Egypt — four countries visible from a single shoreline. Guests enjoy a private beach, an infinity pool seemingly floating above the sea, and direct access to some of the Red Sea's most vibrant coral reefs.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing the sea for jaw-dropping sunsets and views across four countries simultaneously. Then arrange a hotel-organized snorkeling or dive excursion — the reef just offshore is one of the most accessible and unspoiled in the entire Red Sea.
dont_miss: A visit to Wadi Rum , the iconic rose-red desert just 60km away, is unmissable — the hotel can arrange private desert experiences including jeep tours and stargazing camps. Closer to home, explore the ancient Aqaba Castle and the nearby Aqaba Archaeological Museum , or stroll the lively Aqaba waterfront promenade. For divers, the Cedar Pride Shipwreck is a legendary dive site just minutes offshore.
pros: Prime Red Sea waterfront location with direct beach access
Luxury Collection standards with Marriott STARS Program benefits
Gateway to Aqaba's diving and snorkeling opportunities
Strategic location for exploring Jordan's southern attractions
cons: Limited dining options in immediate Aqaba area
Remote location from major Jordanian cultural sites
